# Halliday Architects

> Architecture practice in Ocean City, New Jersey, led by Christopher Halliday
> (RA, LEED AP) and Shannon Halliday. The site is a portfolio of the practice's
> built work — it is not a real estate listings platform and does not publish
> prices or MLS data.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of the practice, services, and featured projects.
- [About](/about): The practice and how it works.
- [Our Team](/team): The people behind the practice.
- [Services](/services): Custom homes, renovations, multi-family, sustainable design.
- [Projects](/projects): Portfolio of completed projects.
- [Contact](/contact): Inquiry form, phone, email, and office address.
